image_description: A close-up photograph of a large, beige-to-pale-orange coral fungus (Ramaria or Clavulina species) growing on the forest floor. The fungus features a dense, intricate network of upright, cylindrical branches rising from a common base, surrounded by dark soil, moss, and decaying leaf litter.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The branching pattern is visible throughout the cluster. Branches emerge from lower sections and subdivide into smaller, finer tips at the top.
